title: Workspace-level package repositories for Databricks Apps will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting November 13, 2026, workspace-level package repositories for Databricks Apps will be automatically enabled for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled. Workspace admins can configure default Python and npm package repositories that apps inherit while still allowing app-level overrides.

See [Configure default package repositories](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/default-package-repositories).
